checked_path.command:
target='/data/qlyu/projects/peptide-binding-nc-benchmark-20261021/evaluation'
if test -e "$target"; then
  probe="$target"
  echo PATH_PRESENT
else
  probe="$target"
  while ! test -e "$probe"; do
    parent=$(dirname -- "$probe")
    if test "$parent" = "$probe"; then break; fi
    probe="$parent"
  done
  echo PATH_MISSING_CHECKING_PARENT
  echo NEAREST_EXISTING_PARENT="$probe"
fi
if test -e "$probe"; then
  if test -w "$probe"; then echo PATH_OR_PARENT_WRITABLE; else echo PATH_OR_PARENT_NOT_WRITABLE; fi
  echo RESOLVED_PATH="$(readlink -f -- "$probe")"
  findmnt -T "$probe" -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS 2>/dev/null || true
  df -hT "$probe" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
